glosses: class (group of students who commenced or completed their education during a particular year)

examples.en: Our class is a small one.
How many boys are in this class?

examples.text: Ele é o mais alto da turma.
examples.en: He's the tallest in the class.

examples.text: Eu ensino inglês a turmas do segundo ano.
examples.en: I teach English to the second year classes.

examples.text: Posso me registrar para aquela turma?
examples.en: Can I register for that class?
